Since `Array#map` always returns an array (truthy), failed lookups yield `[null, null, ...]` rather than `[]`, and `|| []` never kicks in. Since Referer can be absent or spoofed by a client, using it as the sole gate for “host allowed to embed” is a weak authorization control and can be bypassed, making this a security defect (even if similar logic existed previously via `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?`).

But `record_for_host` parses the referer/url via `URI(host)` and then compares using `uri.host`, which is port-stripped (`example.com`). The DB lookup `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` therefore cannot match a stored `example.com:8080`, making such allowlist entries ineffective.
